import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
import numpy as np

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TUFTE_RC = {
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Liberation Serif", "FreeSerif", "Palatino", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.dpi": 200,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.labelcolor": "#666666",
    "axes.labelsize": 11,
    "axes.titlesize": 13,
    "axes.titleweight": "bold",
    "axes.titlepad": 8,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.color": "#999999",
    "ytick.color": "#999999",
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "xtick.direction": "in",
    "ytick.direction": "in",
    "xtick.major.size": 3,
    "ytick.major.size": 3,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.5,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.5,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
    "lines.markersize": 4,
    "legend.frameon": False,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "grid.color": "#eeeeee",
    "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
    "grid.alpha": 0.5,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.3,
}
plt.rcParams.update(TUFTE_RC)

# ── Color palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text2": "#666666",
    "text3": "#999999",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
    "grid": "#eeeeee",
    "ssa": "#e15759",
    "sa": "#f28e2b",
    "eur": "#76b7b2",
    "na": "#4e79a7",
}

REGIONS = ["Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]
REGION_COLORS = [C["ssa"], C["sa"], C["eur"], C["na"]]
REGION_LABELS = ["Sub-Saharan\nAfrica", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("Q1", 6), ("Q2", 14), ("Q3", 25), ("Q4", 42), ("Q5", 68)],
    "South Asia": [("Q1", 12), ("Q2", 24), ("Q3", 39), ("Q4", 56), ("Q5", 78)],
    "Europe": [("Q1", 72), ("Q2", 82), ("Q3", 89), ("Q4", 94), ("Q5", 97)],
    "North America": [("Q1", 75), ("Q2", 85), ("Q3", 92), ("Q4", 96), ("Q5", 99)],
}

age_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("15-24", 38), ("25-34", 32), ("35-44", 26), ("45-54", 18), ("55-64", 11), ("65+", 5)],
    "South Asia": [("15-24", 55), ("25-34", 48), ("35-44", 38), ("45-54", 27), ("55-64", 16), ("65+", 8)],
    "Europe": [("15-24", 98), ("25-34", 96), ("35-44", 93), ("45-54", 88), ("55-64", 79), ("65+", 58)],
    "North America": [("15-24", 99), ("25-34", 97), ("35-44", 95), ("45-54", 91), ("55-64", 84), ("65+", 65)],
}

urban_rural_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("Rural", 13), ("Urban", 42)],
    "South Asia": [("Rural", 22), ("Urban", 58)],
    "Europe": [("Rural", 78), ("Urban", 92)],
    "North America": [("Rural", 80), ("Urban", 95)],
}

overall = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": 27,
    "South Asia": 40,
    "Europe": 89,
    "North America": 93,
}

# ── Gap calculations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_gaps = {r: income_data[r][-1][1] - income_data[r][0][1] for r in REGIONS}
age_gaps = {r: age_data[r][0][1] - age_data[r][-1][1] for r in REGIONS}
ur_gaps = {r: urban_rural_data[r][1][1] - urban_rural_data[r][0][1] for r in REGIONS}

YMIN, YMAX = -2, 105

# ── Helper functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def vgrid(ax):
    for yv in [0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100]:
        ax.axhline(y=yv, color=C["grid"], linewidth=0.35, zorder=0)

def dlabel(ax, x, y, text, color, offset=(4, 0), ha="left", va="center", size=9.5, bold=True):
    ax.annotate(text, xy=(x, y), xytext=offset, textcoords="offset points",
                fontsize=size, color=color, fontfamily="serif",
                ha=ha, va=va, fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal")

# ── Figure: 2-col x 2-row layout ────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 9.5), facecolor=C["bg"])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 0.7], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.35,
                      top=0.90, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.95)

ax_inc = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])   # Income gradient
ax_age = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])   # Age gradient
ax_ur   = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])   # Urban-Rural (spans both columns)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Income Quintile Gradient
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_inc)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(5)
    ys = [v for _, v in income_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    lw = 2.4 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 1.3
    alpha = 1.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 0.50
    ax_inc.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
    ax_inc.scatter(xs, ys, color=color, s=20, alpha=alpha, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", clip_on=False)

# Direct labels at Q5 endpoint
offsets = [(10, -4), (10, 1), (10, 6), (10, 6)]
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(5)
    ys = [v for _, v in income_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    label = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. America"][idx]
    dlabel(ax_inc, xs[-1] + 0.15, ys[-1], label, color, offset=offsets[idx])

# Gap annotations
ax_inc.annotate(f"{income_gaps['Sub-Saharan Africa']}pp", xy=(2.1, 30),
                fontsize=9.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_inc.annotate(f"{income_gaps['South Asia']}pp", xy=(2.4, 52),
                fontsize=9.5, color=C["sa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))

ax_inc.set_xticks(range(5))
ax_inc.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in income_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"]])
ax_inc.set_xlim(-0.25, 5.5)
ax_inc.set_ylim(YMIN, YMAX)
ax_inc.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_inc.set_yticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_inc.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_inc.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 4)
ax_inc.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_inc.set_title("By Income Quintile", fontsize=13, color=C["text"],
                 fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# Arrow annotation highlighting the steep gradient
ax_inc.annotate("", xy=(3.2, 65), xytext=(0.8, 8),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=C["ssa"], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6))
ax_inc.annotate("Steepest\ngradient", xy=(1.8, 35),
                fontsize=8.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic", alpha=0.8)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Age Gradient
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_age)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(6)
    ys = [v for _, v in age_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    lw = 2.4 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 1.3
    alpha = 1.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 0.50
    ax_age.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
    ax_age.scatter(xs, ys, color=color, s=20, alpha=alpha, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", clip_on=False)

# Label SSA and SA at far right (low), Europe and NA at far left (high)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(6)
    ys = [v for _, v in age_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    label = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. America"][idx]
    if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia"):
        dlabel(ax_age, xs[-1] + 0.15, ys[-1], label, color, offset=(12, 0))
    else:
        dlabel(ax_age, xs[0] - 0.15, ys[0], label, color, offset=(-12, 0), ha="right")

# Youth-elder gap annotations
ax_age.annotate(f"Youth-elder\ngap: {age_gaps['Sub-Saharan Africa']}pp",
                xy=(3.0, 22), fontsize=8.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif",
                ha="center", va="center", fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_age.annotate(f"{age_gaps['South Asia']}pp", xy=(3.3, 40),
                fontsize=9, color=C["sa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_age.annotate(f"{age_gaps['Europe']}pp", xy=(5.0, 82),
                fontsize=8.5, color=C["eur"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))

ax_age.set_xticks(range(6))
ax_age.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in age_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"]])
ax_age.set_xlim(-0.4, 6.6)
ax_age.set_ylim(YMIN, YMAX)
ax_age.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_age.set_yticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_age.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_age.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 5)
ax_age.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_age.set_title("By Age Group", fontsize=13, color=C["text"],
                 fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Urban-Rural Gap + Overall (horizontal dumbbell)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_ur)
ypos = [3.5, 2.5, 1.5, 0.5]

for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    y = ypos[idx]
    r_val = urban_rural_data[region][0][1]
    u_val = urban_rural_data[region][1][1]
    o_val = overall[region]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    gap = ur_gaps[region]

    # Connecting line
    lw = 3.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 2.0
    ax_ur.plot([r_val, u_val], [y, y], color=color, linewidth=lw,
               solid_capstyle="round", zorder=3, alpha=0.85)

    # Rural dot
    ax_ur.scatter(r_val, y, color=color, s=70, zorder=4, edgecolors="none")
    # Urban dot (diamond marker for prominence)
    ax_ur.scatter(u_val, y, color=color, s=80, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", marker="D")
    # Overall penetration (square)
    ax_ur.scatter(o_val, y, color=color, s=45, zorder=5, edgecolors="none", marker="s", alpha=0.75)

    # Labels
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Rural\n{r_val}%", xy=(r_val, y), xytext=(-28, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="right", va="center")
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Urban\n{u_val}%", xy=(u_val, y), xytext=(28, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="left", va="center")

    # Gap magnitude centered
    mid = (r_val + u_val) / 2
    ax_ur.annotate(f"{gap}pp gap", xy=(mid, y), xytext=(0, 18),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9.5, color=C["text2"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="bottom", fontstyle="italic")

    # Overall label (small, below)
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Overall {o_val}%", xy=(o_val, y), xytext=(0, -22),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8.5, color=C["text3"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="top")

    # Region label (far left)
    ax_ur.annotate(REGION_LABELS[idx], xy=(-6, y), xytext=(-72, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=11.5, color=C["text"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="left", va="center", fontweight="bold")

# Key for markers
key_text = ("Circle = Rural   Diamond = Urban   Square = Overall   |   "
            "Gap width shown in percentage points (pp)")
ax_ur.annotate(key_text, xy=(0.98, -0.15), xycoords="axes fraction",
               fontsize=8, color=C["text3"], fontfamily="sans-serif",
               ha="right", va="top")

ax_ur.set_xlim(-10, 102)
ax_ur.set_ylim(-1, 4.2)
ax_ur.set_xticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_ur.set_xticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_ur.set_yticks([])
ax_ur.set_xlabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_ur.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_ur.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
ax_ur.set_title("By Urban-Rural Setting (with Overall Penetration)",
                fontsize=13, color=C["text"], fontfamily="serif",
                fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# ── Figure title ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.10, 0.96,
         "The Digital Divide's Sharpest Edge Is Income",
         fontsize=20, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text"], fontweight="bold", ha="left")

fig.text(0.10, 0.935,
         "Internet penetration gaps by income quintile, age group, and urban-rural setting across four world regions (2023)",
         fontsize=11.5, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text2"], ha="left", fontstyle="italic")

# ── Source ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.98, 0.015,
         "Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center (2023 estimates). "
         "Quintiles based on national household income distributions. "
         "Penetration: share of individuals who used the internet in the past three months.",
         fontsize=7.5, color=C["text3"], fontfamily="sans-serif", ha="right", va="bottom")

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", facecolor=C["bg"], edgecolor="none")
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
import numpy as np

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TUFTE_RC = {
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Liberation Serif", "FreeSerif", "Palatino", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.dpi": 200,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.labelcolor": "#666666",
    "axes.labelsize": 11,
    "axes.titlesize": 13,
    "axes.titleweight": "bold",
    "axes.titlepad": 8,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.color": "#999999",
    "ytick.color": "#999999",
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "xtick.direction": "in",
    "ytick.direction": "in",
    "xtick.major.size": 3,
    "ytick.major.size": 3,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.5,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.5,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
    "lines.markersize": 4,
    "legend.frameon": False,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "grid.color": "#eeeeee",
    "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
    "grid.alpha": 0.5,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.3,
}
plt.rcParams.update(TUFTE_RC)

# ── Color palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text2": "#666666",
    "text3": "#999999",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
    "grid": "#eeeeee",
    "ssa": "#e15759",
    "sa": "#f28e2b",
    "eur": "#76b7b2",
    "na": "#4e79a7",
}

REGIONS = ["Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]
REGION_COLORS = [C["ssa"], C["sa"], C["eur"], C["na"]]
REGION_LABELS = ["Sub-Saharan\nAfrica", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("Q1", 6), ("Q2", 14), ("Q3", 25), ("Q4", 42), ("Q5", 68)],
    "South Asia": [("Q1", 12), ("Q2", 24), ("Q3", 39), ("Q4", 56), ("Q5", 78)],
    "Europe": [("Q1", 72), ("Q2", 82), ("Q3", 89), ("Q4", 94), ("Q5", 97)],
    "North America": [("Q1", 75), ("Q2", 85), ("Q3", 92), ("Q4", 96), ("Q5", 99)],
}

age_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("15-24", 38), ("25-34", 32), ("35-44", 26), ("45-54", 18), ("55-64", 11), ("65+", 5)],
    "South Asia": [("15-24", 55), ("25-34", 48), ("35-44", 38), ("45-54", 27), ("55-64", 16), ("65+", 8)],
    "Europe": [("15-24", 98), ("25-34", 96), ("35-44", 93), ("45-54", 88), ("55-64", 79), ("65+", 58)],
    "North America": [("15-24", 99), ("25-34", 97), ("35-44", 95), ("45-54", 91), ("55-64", 84), ("65+", 65)],
}

urban_rural_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("Rural", 13), ("Urban", 42)],
    "South Asia": [("Rural", 22), ("Urban", 58)],
    "Europe": [("Rural", 78), ("Urban", 92)],
    "North America": [("Rural", 80), ("Urban", 95)],
}

overall = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": 27,
    "South Asia": 40,
    "Europe": 89,
    "North America": 93,
}

# ── Gap calculations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_gaps = {r: income_data[r][-1][1] - income_data[r][0][1] for r in REGIONS}
age_gaps = {r: age_data[r][0][1] - age_data[r][-1][1] for r in REGIONS}
ur_gaps = {r: urban_rural_data[r][1][1] - urban_rural_data[r][0][1] for r in REGIONS}

YMIN, YMAX = -2, 105

# ── Helper functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def vgrid(ax):
    for yv in [0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100]:
        ax.axhline(y=yv, color=C["grid"], linewidth=0.35, zorder=0)

def dlabel(ax, x, y, text, color, offset=(4, 0), ha="left", va="center", size=9.5, bold=True):
    ax.annotate(text, xy=(x, y), xytext=offset, textcoords="offset points",
                fontsize=size, color=color, fontfamily="serif",
                ha=ha, va=va, fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal")

# ── Figure: 2-col x 2-row layout ────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 9.5), facecolor=C["bg"])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 0.7], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.35,
                      top=0.90, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.95)

ax_inc = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])   # Income gradient
ax_age = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])   # Age gradient
ax_ur   = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])   # Urban-Rural (spans both columns)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Income Quintile Gradient
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_inc)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(5)
    ys = [v for _, v in income_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    lw = 2.4 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 1.3
    alpha = 1.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 0.50
    ax_inc.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
    ax_inc.scatter(xs, ys, color=color, s=20, alpha=alpha, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", clip_on=False)

# Direct labels at Q5 endpoint
offsets = [(10, -4), (10, 1), (10, 6), (10, 6)]
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(5)
    ys = [v for _, v in income_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    label = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. America"][idx]
    dlabel(ax_inc, xs[-1] + 0.15, ys[-1], label, color, offset=offsets[idx])

# Gap annotations
ax_inc.annotate(f"{income_gaps['Sub-Saharan Africa']}pp", xy=(2.1, 30),
                fontsize=9.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_inc.annotate(f"{income_gaps['South Asia']}pp", xy=(2.4, 52),
                fontsize=9.5, color=C["sa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))

ax_inc.set_xticks(range(5))
ax_inc.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in income_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"]])
ax_inc.set_xlim(-0.25, 5.5)
ax_inc.set_ylim(YMIN, YMAX)
ax_inc.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_inc.set_yticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_inc.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_inc.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 4)
ax_inc.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_inc.set_title("By Income Quintile", fontsize=13, color=C["text"],
                 fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# Arrow annotation highlighting the steep gradient
ax_inc.annotate("", xy=(3.2, 65), xytext=(0.8, 8),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=C["ssa"], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6))
ax_inc.annotate("Steepest\ngradient", xy=(1.8, 35),
                fontsize=8.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic", alpha=0.8)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Age Gradient
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_age)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(6)
    ys = [v for _, v in age_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    lw = 2.4 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 1.3
    alpha = 1.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 0.50
    ax_age.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
    ax_age.scatter(xs, ys, color=color, s=20, alpha=alpha, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", clip_on=False)

# Label SSA and SA at far right (low), Europe and NA at far left (high)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(6)
    ys = [v for _, v in age_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    label = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. America"][idx]
    if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia"):
        dlabel(ax_age, xs[-1] + 0.15, ys[-1], label, color, offset=(12, 0))
    else:
        dlabel(ax_age, xs[0] - 0.15, ys[0], label, color, offset=(-12, 0), ha="right")

# Youth-elder gap annotations
ax_age.annotate(f"Youth-elder\ngap: {age_gaps['Sub-Saharan Africa']}pp",
                xy=(3.0, 22), fontsize=8.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif",
                ha="center", va="center", fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_age.annotate(f"{age_gaps['South Asia']}pp", xy=(3.3, 40),
                fontsize=9, color=C["sa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_age.annotate(f"{age_gaps['Europe']}pp", xy=(5.0, 82),
                fontsize=8.5, color=C["eur"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))

ax_age.set_xticks(range(6))
ax_age.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in age_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"]])
ax_age.set_xlim(-0.4, 6.6)
ax_age.set_ylim(YMIN, YMAX)
ax_age.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_age.set_yticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_age.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_age.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 5)
ax_age.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_age.set_title("By Age Group", fontsize=13, color=C["text"],
                 fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Urban-Rural Gap + Overall (horizontal dumbbell)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_ur)
ypos = [3.5, 2.5, 1.5, 0.5]

for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    y = ypos[idx]
    r_val = urban_rural_data[region][0][1]
    u_val = urban_rural_data[region][1][1]
    o_val = overall[region]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    gap = ur_gaps[region]

    # Connecting line
    lw = 3.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 2.0
    ax_ur.plot([r_val, u_val], [y, y], color=color, linewidth=lw,
               solid_capstyle="round", zorder=3, alpha=0.85)

    # Rural dot
    ax_ur.scatter(r_val, y, color=color, s=70, zorder=4, edgecolors="none")
    # Urban dot (diamond marker for prominence)
    ax_ur.scatter(u_val, y, color=color, s=80, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", marker="D")
    # Overall penetration (square)
    ax_ur.scatter(o_val, y, color=color, s=45, zorder=5, edgecolors="none", marker="s", alpha=0.75)

    # Labels

                   fontfamily="serif", ha="right", va="center")
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Urban\n{u_val}%", xy=(u_val, y), xytext=(28, 0),

    # Gap magnitude centered
    mid = (r_val + u_val) / 2
    ax_ur.annotate(f"{gap}pp gap", xy=(mid, y), xytext=(0, 18),

                   fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="bottom", fontstyle="italic")

    # Overall label (small, below)
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Overall {o_val}%", xy=(o_val, y), xytext=(0, -22),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8.5, color=C["text3"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="top")

    # Region label (far left)
    ax_ur.annotate(REGION_LABELS[idx], xy=(-6, y), xytext=(-72, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=11.5, color=C["text"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="left", va="center", fontweight="bold")

# Key for markers
key_text = ("Circle = Rural   Diamond = Urban   Square = Overall   |   "
            "Gap width shown in percentage points (pp)")
ax_ur.annotate(key_text, xy=(0.98, -0.15), xycoords="axes fraction",
               fontsize=8, color=C["text3"], fontfamily="sans-serif",
               ha="right", va="top")

ax_ur.set_xlim(-10, 102)
ax_ur.set_ylim(-1, 4.2)
ax_ur.set_xticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_ur.set_xticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_ur.set_yticks([])
ax_ur.set_xlabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_ur.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_ur.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
ax_ur.set_title("By Urban-Rural Setting (with Overall Penetration)",
                fontsize=13, color=C["text"], fontfamily="serif",
                fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# ── Figure title ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.10, 0.96,
         "The Digital Divide's Sharpest Edge Is Income",
         fontsize=20, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text"], fontweight="bold", ha="left")

fig.text(0.10, 0.935,
         "Internet penetration gaps by income quintile, age group, and urban-rural setting across four world regions (2023)",
         fontsize=11.5, fontfamily="serif", color=C["text2"], ha="left", fontstyle="italic")

# ── Source ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.98, 0.015,
         "Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center (2023 estimates). "
         "Quintiles based on national household income distributions. "
         "Penetration: share of individuals who used the internet in the past three months.",
         fontsize=7.5, color=C["text3"], fontfamily="sans-serif", ha="right", va="bottom")

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", facecolor=C["bg"], edgecolor="none")
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

# ── Color palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text2": "#666666",
    "text3": "#999999",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
    "grid": "#eeeeee",
    "ssa": "#e15759",
    "sa": "#f28e2b",
    "eur": "#76b7b2",
    "na": "#4e79a7",
}

REGIONS = ["Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]
REGION_COLORS = [C["ssa"], C["sa"], C["eur"], C["na"]]
REGION_LABELS = ["Sub-Saharan\nAfrica", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("Q1", 6), ("Q2", 14), ("Q3", 25), ("Q4", 42), ("Q5", 68)],
    "South Asia": [("Q1", 12), ("Q2", 24), ("Q3", 39), ("Q4", 56), ("Q5", 78)],
    "Europe": [("Q1", 72), ("Q2", 82), ("Q3", 89), ("Q4", 94), ("Q5", 97)],
    "North America": [("Q1", 75), ("Q2", 85), ("Q3", 92), ("Q4", 96), ("Q5", 99)],
}

age_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("15-24", 38), ("25-34", 32), ("35-44", 26), ("45-54", 18), ("55-64", 11), ("65+", 5)],
    "South Asia": [("15-24", 55), ("25-34", 48), ("35-44", 38), ("45-54", 27), ("55-64", 16), ("65+", 8)],
    "Europe": [("15-24", 98), ("25-34", 96), ("35-44", 93), ("45-54", 88), ("55-64", 79), ("65+", 58)],
    "North America": [("15-24", 99), ("25-34", 97), ("35-44", 95), ("45-54", 91), ("55-64", 84), ("65+", 65)],
}

urban_rural_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [("Rural", 13), ("Urban", 42)],
    "South Asia": [("Rural", 22), ("Urban", 58)],
    "Europe": [("Rural", 78), ("Urban", 92)],
    "North America": [("Rural", 80), ("Urban", 95)],
}

overall = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": 27,
    "South Asia": 40,
    "Europe": 89,
    "North America": 93,
}

# ── Gap calculations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_gaps = {r: income_data[r][-1][1] - income_data[r][0][1] for r in REGIONS}
age_gaps = {r: age_data[r][0][1] - age_data[r][-1][1] for r in REGIONS}
ur_gaps = {r: urban_rural_data[r][1][1] - urban_rural_data[r][0][1] for r in REGIONS}

YMIN, YMAX = -2, 105

# ── Helper functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def vgrid(ax):
    for yv in [0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100]:
        ax.axhline(y=yv, color=C["grid"], linewidth=0.35, zorder=0)

def dlabel(ax, x, y, text, color, offset=(4, 0), ha="left", va="center", size=9.5, bold=True):
    ax.annotate(text, xy=(x, y), xytext=offset, textcoords="offset points",
                fontsize=size, color=color, fontfamily="serif",
                ha=ha, va=va, fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal")

# ── Figure: 2-col x 2-row layout ────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 9.5), facecolor=C["bg"])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 0.7], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.35,
                      top=0.90, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.95)

ax_inc = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])   # Income gradient
ax_age = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])   # Age gradient
ax_ur   = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])   # Urban-Rural (spans both columns)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Income Quintile Gradient
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_inc)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(5)
    ys = [v for _, v in income_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    lw = 2.4 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 1.3
    alpha = 1.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 0.50
    ax_inc.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
    ax_inc.scatter(xs, ys, color=color, s=20, alpha=alpha, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", clip_on=False)

# Direct labels at Q5 endpoint
offsets = [(10, -4), (10, 1), (10, 6), (10, 6)]
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(5)
    ys = [v for _, v in income_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    label = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. America"][idx]
    dlabel(ax_inc, xs[-1] + 0.15, ys[-1], label, color, offset=offsets[idx])

# Gap annotations
ax_inc.annotate(f"{income_gaps['Sub-Saharan Africa']}pp", xy=(2.1, 30),
                fontsize=9.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_inc.annotate(f"{income_gaps['South Asia']}pp", xy=(2.4, 52),
                fontsize=9.5, color=C["sa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))

ax_inc.set_xticks(range(5))
ax_inc.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in income_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"]])
ax_inc.set_xlim(-0.25, 5.5)
ax_inc.set_ylim(YMIN, YMAX)
ax_inc.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_inc.set_yticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_inc.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])
ax_inc.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 4)
ax_inc.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_inc.set_title("By Income Quintile", fontsize=13, color=C["text"],
                 fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=6)

# Arrow annotation highlighting the steep gradient
ax_inc.annotate("", xy=(3.2, 65), xytext=(0.8, 8),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=C["ssa"], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6))
ax_inc.annotate("Steepest\ngradient", xy=(1.8, 35),
                fontsize=8.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic", alpha=0.8)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Age Gradient
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vgrid(ax_age)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(6)
    ys = [v for _, v in age_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    lw = 2.4 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 1.3
    alpha = 1.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 0.50
    ax_age.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
    ax_age.scatter(xs, ys, color=color, s=20, alpha=alpha, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", clip_on=False)

# Label SSA and SA at far right (low), Europe and NA at far left (high)
for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    xs = np.arange(6)
    ys = [v for _, v in age_data[region]]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    label = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. America"][idx]
    if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia"):
        dlabel(ax_age, xs[-1] + 0.15, ys[-1], label, color, offset=(12, 0))
    else:
        dlabel(ax_age, xs[0] - 0.15, ys[0], label, color, offset=(-12, 0), ha="right")

# Youth-elder gap annotations
ax_age.annotate(f"Youth-elder\ngap: {age_gaps['Sub-Saharan Africa']}pp",
                xy=(3.0, 22), fontsize=8.5, color=C["ssa"], fontfamily="serif",
                ha="center", va="center", fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_age.annotate(f"{age_gaps['South Asia']}pp", xy=(3.3, 40),
                fontsize=9, color=C["sa"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=C["bg"], ec=C["axis"], lw=0.35, alpha=0.92))
ax_age.annotate(f"{age_gaps['Europe']}pp", xy=(5.0, 82),
                fontsize=8.5, color=C["eur"], fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="center",
                fontstyle="italic",

ax_age.set_xticks(range(6))
ax_age.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in age_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"]])

ax_age.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 5)
ax_age.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax_age.set_title("By Age Group", fontsize=13, color=C["text"],

vgrid(ax_ur)

    u_val = urban_rural_data[region][1][1]
    o_val = overall[region]
    color = REGION_COLORS[idx]
    gap = ur_gaps[region]

    # Connecting line
    lw = 3.0 if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia") else 2.0
    ax_ur.plot([r_val, u_val], [y, y], color=color, linewidth=lw,

    ax_ur.scatter(r_val, y, color=color, s=70, zorder=4, edgecolors="none")
    # Urban dot (diamond marker for prominence)
    ax_ur.scatter(u_val, y, color=color, s=80, zorder=4, edgecolors="none", marker="D")
    # Overall penetration (square)
    ax_ur.scatter(o_val, y, color=color, s=45, zorder=5, edgecolors="none", marker="s", alpha=0.75)

    ax_ur.annotate(f"Rural\n{r_val}%", xy=(r_val, y), xytext=(-28, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="right", va="center")
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Urban\n{u_val}%", xy=(u_val, y), xytext=(28, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="left", va="center")

    # Gap magnitude centered
    mid = (r_val + u_val) / 2
    ax_ur.annotate(f"{gap}pp gap", xy=(mid, y), xytext=(0, 18),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9.5, color=C["text2"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="bottom", fontstyle="italic")

    # Overall label (small, below)
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Overall {o_val}%", xy=(o_val, y), xytext=(0, -22),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8.5, color=C["text3"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="center", va="top")

    # Region label (far left)
    ax_ur.annotate(REGION_LABELS[idx], xy=(-6, y), xytext=(-72, 0),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=11.5, color=C["text"],
                   fontfamily="serif", ha="left", va="center", fontweight="bold")

ax_ur.set_ylim(-1, 4.2)

ax_ur.set_xticklabels(["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100%"])
ax_ur.set_yticks([])
ax_ur.set_xlabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=11, color=C["text2"])

Chart generated at `/app/output/result.png` — a 3-panel small-multiples visualization covering all five goals:

- **Panel 1 (Income Quintile)**: Line chart showing the steep Q1→Q5 gradient, with 62pp and 66pp gaps annotated for Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia
- **Panel 2 (Age Group)**: Line chart showing the youth-to-elder decline across 6 age bands, with gap annotations highlighting 33–47pp divides
- **Panel 3 (Urban-Rural)**: Dumbbell chart with region labels, showing rural/urban endpoints, gap magnitudes, and overall penetration markers

Design follows Tufte principles: no top/right spines, direct labels (no legend), range-frame axes, `#fffff8` background, serif typography, muted categorical palette warm→cool (SSA coral → NA steel blue), and an assertive title. All 56 source data points are faithfully represented.
